audit.naming: Semantic color and typography roles are shared. Platform aliases remain component tokens. Component geometry remains with its owner; raw values are an inventory rather than a universal scale.
unresolvedDesignDecisions: Typography roles are applied; a universal spacing/radius scale is intentionally not asserted for unrelated component geometry.
Different control heights and focus widths remain actual per-component decisions, not a unified standard.
Windows browser shell is a reference. Native Windows panels, notifications and accessibility behavior remain unverified.
Native macOS accessibility and shell behavior are not established by this web prototype.
